A table nested in a single-cell row renders as its own table

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<table><tr><th>Summary</th></tr><tr><td>Before<table><tr><th>Item</th><th>Amount</th></tr><tr><td>Alpha</td><td>10</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
